pages.text: “Dark tea liquor, rich and intense, holding a hidden burst of energy beneath the roasting fire.”$(br2)Black Tea is a warm and invigorating beverage made from two portions of dried black tea leaves. The amber-colored tea is clear and has a robust flavor. Drinking it grants the Haste effect, making travelers move and act with greater agility.

$(br2)$(br)To brew Black Tea, $(br)boil two portions of dried black tea leaves.$(br)This tea is ideal for combat or high-speed resource gathering, allowing for quicker reactions and increased efficiency.

Upon drinking Black Tea, travelers will receive a Haste effect, temporarily increasing mining and attack speed.$(br)This tea is perfect for battle or high-intensity labor.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
